authority.name: Global Biodiversity Information Facility
authority.publisher: GBIF Secretariat and the occurrence-record publishers identified in the retained responses

terms.license: Retained occurrence records declare CC BY 4.0, CC BY-NC 4.0, or CC0 1.0 record-level licenses.

geography.method: Registered exact provider county-equivalent text resolution: GBIF county text Apache uniquely resolves to active FIPS 04001, Apache County, Arizona; GBIF county text Coconino or Coconino County uniquely resolves to active FIPS 04005, Coconino County, Arizona.
geography.coordinatePolicy: Coordinate-derived county routing is forbidden for this run. Only explicit registered GBIF county text was considered; coordinates were neither used nor permitted to derive county identity.

taxonomy.method: Registered strict GBIF EXACT species match with confidence at least 95 and exact canonical binomial agreement; Cirsium arvense matched GBIF speciesKey 3113414 at confidence 99, and Melilotus officinalis matched GBIF speciesKey 8193111 at confidence 98.

requests.purpose: Resolve the exact registered target binomial to a stable GBIF species key before occurrence acquisition.

limitations: GBIF record silence, missing county text, rejected candidates, and empty or failed requests never support verified absence or not-detected claims.

caveats: GBIF is an aggregator and publisher record quality can vary.
Accepted records are historical point-scale preserved-specimen evidence and do not imply countywide abundance or current distribution.
